strategic_thesis: This project's focus on Building Electrification directly satisfies NSF's program objectives under PD-18-7607. The proposed scope advances target reliability and decarbonization outcomes while meeting the applicant readiness and commercial deployment criteria.
criteria_strengths: Direct technology alignment with NSF's stated focus on Building Electrification and sector decarbonization.
Project maturity (TRL 5) matches the programmatic deployment and demonstration window.
High geographic and jurisdiction relevance for Paul Smiths, NY infrastructure priorities.
potential_risks_or_flags: Ensure proposal explicitly addresses institutional cost-share and local community benefit requirements.
recommended_positioning: Frame the proposal around accelerating NSF's clean energy mandates with measurable metrics in hosting capacity, peak relief, and emissions reduction.
